title: First Recorded Modern Start
description: MRRA D1 Coca-Cola 600 at Charlotte. Wispy qualified 6th and finished 2nd.

title: First NRRS Win
description: Jaxon earned the first recorded NRRS victory for the team at Iowa Speedway.

title: First iRacing Dirt Win
description: Joshua Douglas scored a major dirt victory in the Chili Bowl on iRacing.

title: First iRacing Crown Jewel
description: Nicholas Waggoner won the Indianapolis 500, adding a major crown jewel to the record book.

title: 25th Recorded Team Win
description: Nicholas Waggoner added an iRacing Trucks victory at Michigan, giving Aetherwing its 25th recorded win.

title: Wispy — 5× Chase Qualifier
description: The NRRS Season 3 berth became Wispy’s fifth confirmed Chase appearance across NRRS, Kmart, and UARL.
